items.title: Buurman rescues late Chelsea win against PSG
items.description: Veerle Buurman scores an 87th-minute winner for Chelsea as they edge past Paris St-Germain 1-0 in the Women's Champions League to move top of the table.

items.title: Chelsea snatch late winner vs PSG to move top of WCL table
items.description: Veerle Buurman's late winner snatched a late 1-0 win for Chelsea against Paris Saint-Germain to move them to the top of the Champions League table.

items.title: Ukrainian FA to blame for failed drugs test - Mudryk
items.description: Tottenham's on-loan Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk says he blames the Ukrainian Association of Football for his failed drugs test and subsequent ban.

items.title: England defender Carter joins Bay FC after Gotham exit
items.description: England defender Jess Carter completes a move to Bay FC after leaving Gotham FC as a free agent.

items.title: Strasbourg appoint Swansea boss Matos
items.description: Strasbourg appoint Swansea City's Vitor Matos as the club's new head coach.

items.title: FA explored legal challenge to Infantino staying on
items.description: The Football Association considered challenging Gianni Infantino's eligibility to run for a fourth term as Fifa president, but it felt a case was likely to fail.

items.title: Hemp and Shaw star as Manchester City get vital win at Hacken
items.description: Substitutes Lauren Hemp and Khadija Shaw both get on the scoresheet to help Manchester City secure a crucial 2-0 win against Swedish side Hacken in the Champions League.

items.title: Hemp stars as Man City beat Hacken in Champions League
items.description: Lauren Hemp scored one and assisted another as Manchester City beat BK Hacken 2-0 in their penultimate Women's Champions League league phase game on Wednesday.

items.title: Leicester split with sponsor after porn actress row
items.description: A fans group had complained after BC Game appointed a porn actress as a brand ambassador.

items.title: From kit boy to manager at 28 - Dumbarton appoint Fellowes
items.description: Martin Fellowes becomes the youngest manager in SPFL history, taking on the Dumbarton job at the age of 28.
